records.jp: ほおー！　綺麗なとこ
records.en_original: Wow, it's beautiful!
records.en: Whoa! What a beautiful place.

records.jp: なんだか不思議な景色……。<CR>上手く言えないけど
records.en_original: What a strange place... It's hard to put it into words.
records.en: It's such a strange landscape...<CR>I can't quite put it into words.

records.jp: 見慣れない景色……な気がするよね
records.en_original: I don't think I've ever seen a place like this.
records.en: It feels unfamiliar somehow.

records.jp: あ、あれ――
records.en_original: I-is that—
records.en: I-is that—

records.jp: ついに……大陸に……話でしか知らなかった<CR>大陸に着いた！　海を越えて……！
records.en_original: Finally... I have reached it... The land I only knew from stories! I crossed the sea to see it for myself!
records.en: At last... the mainland... The mainland I knew only from stories!<CR>I crossed the sea and finally reached it...!

records.jp: ふぅ……やっと着いた
records.en_original: Whew, I made it...!
records.en: Whew... finally.

records.jp: これが……王都……！<CR>すごい、こんなに大きいんだ！
records.en_original: So, this is the capital... It's so big!
records.en: So this is... the royal capital...!<CR>Wow, it's huge!

records.jp: ……完全に舐めてたなあ。<CR>やっぱり王都って言うだけのことはあったわ
records.en_original: ... I completely underestimated it. I guess it IS a big deal, after all.
records.en: ...I completely underestimated it.<CR>I guess it really deserves to be called the royal capital.

records.jp: 広さだけならクーケン島だってそれなりだと思うけど、<CR>あっちは畑しかないしなあ
records.en_original: I always thought Kurken Island felt big, but it's all mostly just fields and farms.
records.en: Kurken Island is fairly big too,<CR>but it's mostly just fields.

records.jp: お、王都！？　クーケン島って……？
records.en_original: Th-the capital?! Kurken Island...?
records.en: Th-the royal capital?! And Kurken Island...?

records.jp: これ……誰の記憶？
records.en_original: Whose memories are these...?
records.en: Whose memory is this...?

records.jp: わ、分かんない！
records.en_original: I-I don't know!
records.en: I-I don't know!

records.jp: 何だろう、聞いたことない地名……。外国……？
records.en_original: I've never heard of those places... Could they be from a different country?
records.en: I've never heard those place names... Another country?

records.jp: 新しい土地、新しい景色。<CR>あたしの冒険は、この王都で始まった
records.en_original: A new place with new sights. My adventure began here, in the capital.
records.en: New land, new scenery.<CR>My adventure began here in the royal capital.

records.jp: えっ、な、なに、なんなのこれ！？
records.en_original: Wh-What's going on!?
records.en: Wh-what is this?!

records.jp: な、なんだった……んん！？
records.en_original: Wh-What the—? Huh!?
records.en: Wh-what was that...? Huh?!

records.jp: ……フィー……うん、フィーにしよう。<CR>どう？　フィー
records.en_original: ...Fi? Yeah, let's call you Fi.
records.en: ...Fi... Yeah, I'll call you Fi.<CR>How does that sound, Fi?

records.jp: フィフィ～！
records.en_original: Fi-fii!
records.en: Fi-fii!

records.jp: よし、今からあんたの名前はフィーで決まりね。<CR>あたしはライザだよ。よろしくね！
records.en_original: Okay! As of today, you are officially Fi! And I'm Ryza.
records.en: All right, from now on your name is Fi.<CR>I'm Ryza. Nice to meet you!

records.jp: フィー！
records.en_original: Fii!
records.en: Fii!

records.jp: 仲間との出会い。冒険の始まり。<CR>あたしの胸はワクワクでいっぱいだった――
records.en_original: New friends. A new adventure. I was so excited.
records.en: Meeting new companions. The start of an adventure.<CR>My heart was brimming with excitement—

records.jp: 終わっ、た……？
records.en_original: It's over...?
records.en: It's... over?

records.jp: みたいだね……
records.en_original: It seems that way...
records.en: Looks like it...

records.jp: これって、明らかにあたしたちの記憶じゃないよね？
records.en_original: These definitely aren't our memories, right?
records.en: These obviously aren't our memories, right?

records.jp: うん、ライザっていう、別の……
records.en_original: Yes, these must be someone else's memories...
records.en: Yeah. Someone else named Ryza...

records.jp: ど、どういうこと！？<CR>ココロトープって、こんなこともあるの？
records.en_original: B-but how?! Is this a normal thing for Heartscapes?
records.en: B-but how?!<CR>Can something like this happen in a Heartscape?

records.jp: 私たちにも全貌が分かってるわけじゃないしなぁ……
records.en_original: We still don't know everything about them, I guess...
records.en: It's not like we understand everything about Heartscapes...

records.jp: ライザって人がこの世界のどこかにいるってことかな？
records.en_original: I wonder if this Ryza person is somewhere in this world?
records.en: Could this Ryza person be somewhere in this world?

records.jp: まだ見てないけど、そのうち現れる？<CR>でも、どういうつながりが……
records.en_original: I haven't seen anyone that could be her, but maybe she'll show up. I just don't know how all of this is connected...
records.en: We haven't seen her, but could she appear eventually?<CR>Still, what could the connection be...?

records.jp: いるにせよ、いないにせよ……<CR>何か、イレギュラーが起きてるような気がするんだよね
records.en_original: Either way, it feels like something weird is happening.
records.en: Whether she's here or not...<CR>I feel like some kind of irregularity is happening.

records.jp: 一応、確認するけど！<CR>ここにいるの全員日本人だよね！？
records.en_original: Just to be sure, we're all from Japan, right?
records.en: Just checking!<CR>Everyone here is Japanese, right?!

records.jp: だよね……ふむ
records.en_original: That's what I thought... Hm...
records.en: Right... Hmm.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん……なんだかちょっと楽しそう？
records.en_original: Ao... You seem like you're having fun.
records.en: Ao-chan... you seem kind of excited?

records.jp: だって、『クーケン島』に<CR>『海を越えてたどり着いた王都』だよ！
records.en_original: Didn't you hear her? Kurken Island! Sea travel!
records.en: It's Kurken Island<CR>and a royal capital she reached by crossing the sea!

records.jp: なんだか冒険の予感がしない？
records.en_original: I have the feeling that we have an adventure on our hands!
records.en: Doesn't it sound like the start of an adventure?

records.jp: ……ま、星崎さんはいつもそうだよね
records.en_original: Well, I wouldn't have expected anything else from Hoshizaki.
records.en: ...Well, that's just like you, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 先進んでみよ！　何か分かるかも
records.en_original: Let's keep going! We may find something.
records.en: Let's keep going! Maybe we'll learn something.
